title: Big City
summary: Lace Waterfall, Rubella and Lillith's band, travel to a gig in Glamora with gigantic 1980s metal hair already done: airport security, plane, bus terminal, bus roof hatch, taxi sunroof, freight elevator. Nothing fits. They're late; the house guitarist (Kenji, not in the band) covers the solo until the hair comes through the curtain and they walk on to play the rest of Big City. On the final chorus their hair rises through the club skylight and joins the hair-tower skyline. Kenji speaks the tag twice from the wings. Product off-screen. Not the Ultra Screech ad. Alternate arc kept: The Appointment Day.
visualArc: Kenji tag on the empty stage → airport security (a cymbal comes out of the hair) → jet bridge and overhead bins → landing over the hair skyline → bus terminal revolving door → riding the bus through the roof hatch → taxi past the laundromat portholes → the freight elevator yields → Kenji covers the solo as Lace Waterfall walk on → bridge on stage → final chorus → hair through the skylight joins the skyline (drop) → Kenji tag again from the wings.

segments.label: A — Kenji tag, empty stage
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Start from a small nightclub stage before the show, not an arena: two empty silver microphone stands, a drum kit on a low riser with LACE WATERFALL painted on the kick drum head, amps, a sealed red fire extinguisher beside one amp, magenta and cyan light only in the gaps of the backline. Stage right in the wings, half in shadow, a glam guitarist with teased hair and a black leather fringe jacket, guitar at his side, looks at a tour poster taped to the wall showing two women with gigantic metal hair, and speaks one dry sentence, mouth barely open, not smiling. No band on stage. No logo wall, no bottle. Locked camera. 8 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: B1 — Airport security, the cymbal
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. Photoreal airport security checkpoint in flat daylight, a walk-through scanner arch of ordinary height, two glamorous women in modern black lace with gigantic 1980s metal hair — one a three-foot jet-black crimped tower with a magenta streak and two drumsticks through it, the other a four-foot-wide dark sideways mane with a platinum-white streak — standing in front of the arch, which reaches only their shoulders; a deadpan security agent waves them around it; two black road cases on the x-ray belt stencilled LACE WATERFALL; the women drop bobby pins into a grey plastic tray, then the woman with the tower pulls a full brass cymbal out of her hair and lays it in the tray. No airline logos, no readable signs. Locked camera. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: B2 — Jet bridge and cabin
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. Photoreal airliner cabin in soft daylight, two glamorous women in modern black lace seated side by side, their gigantic 1980s metal hair — a tall jet-black crimped tower with a magenta streak and a four-foot-wide dark sideways mane with a white streak — rising up and filling four open overhead bins along the aisle; a flight attendant in a plain uniform gently presses one bin shut on a lock of hair; passengers in the rows behind can see nothing but hair; the two women sit calmly, seatbelts on. No airline logo, no readable text. Slow push down the aisle. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: D2 — Window seat, landing
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Photoreal airliner window at dusk, inside the cabin a woman's enormous dark teased mane with one platinum-white streak pressed against the glass, and outside below, a night city skyline whose towers are made of photoreal teased glam hair with magenta and cyan light only in the gaps between strands, rising into view as the plane descends; the hair in the window looks bigger than the city. No text, no logos. Locked camera on the window. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: E — Hair skyline, chorus open
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Photoreal night city street looking up: the skyline is enormous teased glam hair reading as towers and fire escapes, not a cartoon beehive. Magenta and cyan neon sits in the gaps BETWEEN strands, never as a logo on the hair. Two small figures with very large hair on wet asphalt, carrying road cases, looking up. Title hits brighten building-lights in the hair, not signage. No shampoo bottle, no concert stage, no billboard product. 8 seconds. Grok Imagine style

segments.label: E3 — Bus terminal
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. Photoreal city bus terminal at night, fluorescent and tiled, two glamorous women in modern black lace with gigantic 1980s metal hair carrying black road cases stencilled LACE WATERFALL; they squeeze through a glass revolving door, the hair pressing against the glass, and go around a second full time before stepping out; as they pass under a hanging split-flap departure board the hair brushes it and every flap flips; in the far background a delivery man in a red uniform walks across at a steady pace holding a pizza box level at chest height, not looking at them. No readable destinations, no company logos. Locked wide. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: F2 — The bus, roof hatch
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Photoreal city bus driving down a wide avenue at dusk, filmed from a car alongside, two glamorous women in black lace standing inside with their heads and gigantic 1980s metal hair poking up through the open roof hatch — one tall black crimped tower with a magenta streak, one huge sideways dark mane with a white streak — the hair streaming backward in the wind like flags; a low concrete overpass approaches, both women tilt their heads together at the last second and the hair brushes along the underside of the bridge and springs back up; their faces calm. No bus company logo, no ad panels with text. Tracking alongside. 15 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: G8 — Taxi past the laundromat
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Photoreal night city street, a plain dark taxi with no logo drives past a brightly lit laundromat window, two women's gigantic metal hairstyles rising out of the taxi's open sunroof; in the laundromat window a row of round dryer portholes reflects the passing hair so it looks like it is spinning inside the machines, gold and green in the glass. Magenta and cyan only in the gaps between strands. No signage text. Locked camera on the laundromat window as the taxi passes. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: G9 — Stage door, the elevator yields
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Photoreal club back corridor, concrete and band stickers with nothing readable, a freight elevator with its doors open on a car whose ceiling is far too low for two women in black lace with gigantic 1980s metal hair holding road cases; as they step forward, the elevator car slowly sinks two feet below the floor level so the hair will fit, they step down into it calmly, and the doors slide shut. Magenta and cyan light in the hair gaps only. Locked camera. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: H — Solo, Kenji covers, the band walks on
segments.onScreen: Solo, Kenji covers, the band walks on
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. Small nightclub stage, magenta and cyan light only in the backline gaps: a glam guitarist with teased hair and a black leather fringe jacket plays a solo alone at centre stage; behind him the stage curtain bulges and two gigantic 1980s metal hairstyles push through the gap first, followed by two glamorous women in modern black lace, one carrying a black angular guitar, one a white bass; they walk to two silver microphones and plug in while the guitarist backs away into the shadow of the wings, still playing; a drum kit behind with LACE WATERFALL on the kick drum, the drummer hidden entirely behind the women's hair. No logos, no bottle. Locked wide. 15 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: I — Bridge, Lace Waterfall on stage
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Small nightclub stage, two-shot: Rubella in modern black lace at the right silver mic with a white bass, a huge sideways dark metal mane with a platinum-white streak, singing dry, and Lillith in black lace at the left mic with a black angular guitar, a tall jet-black crimped hair tower with a magenta streak and drumsticks through it, answering high; their hair fills the top of the frame and hides the drummer; magenta and cyan light in the gaps between strands; a guitarist is only a shadow in the wings; a sealed red fire extinguisher beside the amp. They sing this record. Micro-push on the snare. No bottle, no logo wall. 15 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: J — Final chorus, Lace Waterfall
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Small nightclub stage: two women in modern black lace with gigantic 1980s metal hair stacked on the title Big City at two silver mics, black guitar and white bass, drummer hidden behind their hair, micro-push on each title hit; intercut: the crowd from behind, ordinary people with ordinary hair, all heads tilted up toward the band's hair. Magenta and cyan in the gaps only. No logo wall, no bottle. 8 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: J6 — Through the roof
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Photoreal night city skyline made of towers of enormous teased glam hair with magenta and cyan light in the gaps; out of the roof of a small nightclub in the middle of it, two new hair towers rise up through an open skylight — one jet-black and crimped with a magenta streak, one wide and dark with a platinum-white streak — climbing until they stand as tall as the other towers, warm stage light pouring out between their strands. Building intact, skylight open. Slow push-in. 10 seconds, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: J7 — Skyline and stage, last chorus
segments.grokImaginePrompt: No lip sync. No one is singing. The hair performs the beat. Night skyline of teased-hair towers, the two newest towers rising from a small club roof, one warm window lit high in the crown of the black one after the rest of the street has gone dark, magenta and cyan only in the gaps, empty sidewalk below. 8 seconds. Grok Imagine style

segments.label: K2 — Kenji tag, full stage
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Return to the opening framing: small nightclub stage from the wings, a glam guitarist with teased hair and a black leather fringe jacket half in shadow stage right, guitar at his side, and beyond him two women in modern black lace at the microphones whose gigantic metal hair rises up and out of the top of the frame; he looks up at the hair and speaks one dry sentence, mouth barely open, not sold. Magenta and cyan in the gaps only. No bottle, no logo wall. 8 seconds, Grok Imagine style
